page.overview:
Who is Elderly swordsman?

A resident of the village of Gaipan, the elderly swordsman was among the citizens who gathered when the Rough Rhinos arrived at the settlement in the 90s AG. The village leadership quickly surrendered to the Fire Nationals, seeking to ensure their survival. Frustrated at the easy victory, the Rough Rhinos' leader, Colonel Mongke, grabbed the village leader and demanded that he duel him. At this point, the elderly swordsman stepped forward and declared his willingness to fight despite the colonel's protest that he was "pathetic". Even though the swordsman displayed some skill, he quickly tipped and fell due to his advanced age. Though utterly disappointed at this anticlimactic outcome, Mongke spared the old man.

The elderly swordsman was among those villagers of Gaipan who left or were expelled after the Fire Nation occupation began. As he moved through the nearby woods with his belongings, the old man encountered a young boy named Jet by chance. The latter recognized him from the attempted challenge in Gaipan, accusing him of "running away" after failing to fight Mongke. The swordsman tried to convey that his own fighting spirit remained unbroken, but his body was failing him. When Jet remained unimpressed, the old man attacked the young boy. While the boy evaded the swordsman's strikes, the elder asked whether Jet was truly willing to relentlessly battle the Fire Nation.

When Jet eventually screamed that destroying the Fire Nation was "all that I have left", the swordsman was satisfied. He passed his hook swords to the boy and respectfully bowed, declaring that Jet displayed the necessary spirit to fight. Afterward, the old man grumbled about his back pain and continued his journey.
